mathcounts-potw-2026-10-05-02.title: Move the decimal
mathcounts-potw-2026-10-05-02.body:
$3.8 \times 10^6$ mL $= 3{,}800{,}000$ mL. Dividing by 1000 moves the decimal 3 places left: $3800$ L $= 3.8 \times 10^3$ L.

**Answer: $3.8 \times 10^3$ L**

mathcounts-potw-2026-10-05-03.title: Compute in liters
mathcounts-potw-2026-10-05-03.body:
In decimeters: $r = 0.5$ dm, $h = 5$ dm, $V = \pi(0.25)(5) = 1.25\pi \approx 3.927$ dm³ $= 3.927$ L $= 3927$ cm³.

**Answer: 3927 cm³**
